outline:
本課程針對各種資源之特性，使學生瞭解開發各類資源之方法及各種機器之應用。其內容包括：資源探勘、資源蘊藏量評估、資源開拓、資源開採、地下開採、地面開採、大型機器之應用及特殊工程施工。
Various mining exploitation methods and mining equipment involved are introduced in this class. It includes exploration, reserve calculation, resource exploitation, and mining operations (underground and surface).
schedule:
第1週 Introduction, element of mining
第2週 development of mining technology
第3週- stages in the life of a mine, unit operations of mining
第4週- economics of the mineral industries
第5週 prospecting and geologic
第6週-prospecting: geophysical and geochemical
第7週exploration genreal
第8週 exploration methods
第9週 期中考
第10週mine development
第11週 development: financing and implementation
第12週exploitation general
第13週 mining method
第14週 fundamental operations and cycles
第15週 drilling and rock penetration
第16週 blasting and excavation
17週 haulage and hoisting
第18週 期末考
assessment:
期中考: 40%
期末考: 40%
平時成績: 20%
